buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address OFFICE OF THE CHIEF ENGINEER, PIDD AND NODAL OFFICER , WBSDA DATA CENTRE COMPLEX, 4TH FLOOR NEW TOWN , BLOCK AF STREET NO 41 KOLKATA 700163 . 3. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 4. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 5. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the

bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 6. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ATC: 1. Performance Certificate: Supply and delivery of similar kind of app liances /categories of minimum value of Rs 45, 000.00/- (Forty five thousand only) must have been executed successfully irrespective of Make and Model in single order. Relevant CRAC must be submitt ed in support of successful delivery against the respective order. 2. Dispute Resolution Mechanism (DRM): Any dispute arises in betwe en buyer and seller during execution of the BID /Order, the issue sh all be resolved through mutual amicable settlement and if required , matter may be dealt with any court under the jurisdiction of Hon’b le High Court, Calcutta. 3. Valid Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) authorization certific ate indicating valid Manufacture Authorization Form (MAF) must be substantiated in support of authorized seller/dealer. 4. In case of any discrepancy or anomaly found during delivery of ma terial/product other than the required specification as mentioned in the concerned BID document, the concerned material shall be rejec ted and appropriate action shall be taken by the buyer. 5. Bidder turnover: Documentary evidence in the form of certified Au dited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the C hartered Accountant / Cost Accountant (with valid UDIN number) in dicating the turnover details for the relevant period last three (03) years i.e, 2023-24, 2024-25, and 2025-26 shall be uploaded with th e bid. Average annual turnover of last three (03) years to be not le ss than 1 lakh rupees. 6. To be an eligible bidder, the bidder has to quote, supply and deliv er the entire quantity of the individual items as asked in the BID.
